quote.text: It is way more pleasurable to master yourself than it is to masturbate.
quote.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Mastering oneself within the family teaches restraint and compassion—a gift not only of virtue but one that children witness and emulate.
    • Just as the wise parent models self-discipline, so too does one nurture inner strength, instilling in young minds the importance of thoughtful control over fleeting indulgences.
  • Leadership:
    • True leadership begins with self-mastery; when one controls their own passions and desires, they can better guide others toward collective purpose and stability.
    • In the realm of leadership, discipline serves as the foundation for decision-making and fosters a clear, focused vision, just as a steady hand on the helm directs a ship safely through turbulent seas.
  • Product Management:
    • Product management requires the same internal mastery as any great endeavor; by mastering personal impulses, one ensures a balanced, innovative approach rather than taking the easier, self-indulgent path of short-term fixes.
    • The discipline to prioritize long-term vision over immediate gratification translates into creating products that stand the test of time, much as the wise man’s focus yields enduring success.
